arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = table
SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',c.charge_id,json_object('booking',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered'

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,b.flight_id,h.booking_id AS hold_id,f.price_cents,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state AS charge_state,e.event_id AS cancellation,r.amount_cents AS refund_cents FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN flights f ON f.flight_id=b.flight_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.charge_id=c.charge_id WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed'
